body:
Base4Matrix (flat row-major, matching array.prn's NDArray convention). rows/cols/dims-eq/stack2 (2-row)/matrix-eq/matmul. Two real compiler gaps found and flagged: sibling same-named loop bindings collide at C emission (worked around); matmul's accumulator hits the same double-boxing bug already confirmed on base4/vector.prn's dot (verified directly, not fixed -- same cross-cutting issue). make test-base4-matrix green, -Werror clean. PARENA commit 8f56f97.

⚓ ☃
